descriptions.text: In-memory item cache keyed by name; nothing is written to disk.
A catalogue book with a name and a price.
A catalogue toy with a name and a price, displayed with an upper-case label.
Places orders: keeps cheap items in a cache and others in a file store, and produces receipt lines.
Persistent item store: keeps saved items in memory and mirrors them to a JSON file at a given path.
Command-line entry point: builds an order service and places two sample orders, printing each receipt.
Package marker for the shop package; its docstring names the parts: catalogue models, storage back-ends and order handling.
In-memory cache with the same save interface as the file store, keyed by item name.
Catalogue item models: books and toys, each with a name and a price.
Order handling: places orders, keeps each item in a cache or file store, and builds receipt lines.
File-backed store that keeps saved catalogue items and writes them to a JSON file.
Formatting helpers: currency-prefixed prices, hyphenated slugs and number parsing.
Creates an OrderService (orders file from the first argument, default orders.json), places a sample book and toy, and prints their receipts.
Starts with an empty name-to-item mapping.
Static factory that returns a new, empty cache.
Returns the cached item for a name, or None if there is none.
Stores an item under its name, replacing any previous item with that name.
Stores the book's name and price.
Returns a display string for the book, e.g. 'Book: Dune'.
Stores the toy's name and price.
Returns a display string for the toy built from its upper-case label, e.g. 'Toy: KITE'.
Returns the toy's name in upper case.
Creates a file store at the given path and an in-memory cache.
Records an item and returns its receipt line.
Builds a receipt line from the item's slugified name and formatted price.
Saves an item to the cache if it costs under 10, otherwise to the file store, which writes to disk.
Remembers the target file path and starts with an empty item list.
Appends an item and rewrites the whole JSON file with every saved item's name and price (writes to disk).
Converts one item to a name/price dictionary for the JSON file.
Formats an amount with two decimals, prefixed by its currency symbol (EUR by default).
Prefixes text with the symbol of the enclosing call's currency, falling back to the currency code itself.
Turns text into a lower-case, hyphen-separated slug.
Parses a value as a float. Shadowed by the later to_amount definition, so it is never used at runtime.
Parses a value as a float rounded to two decimals; this definition replaces the earlier one.

edges.note: service is the OrderService created on line 11, so service.place is OrderService.place.
backend is self.cache when the price is under 10 (line 20); self.cache is a Cache (line 13).
backend is self.store otherwise (line 20); self.store is a Store (line 12).
